finalText:
`account_id` appears 1291 times across 94 files. Four zones must keep the old name.

| Zone | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|
| SQL strings in `services/*/src/repo/` | 125 | Real column name, never renamed |
| `migrations/` | 61 | Already applied in production |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | `vendor:refresh` overwrites edits |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract, needs new dated version |
| `lib/serialize.js` wire value | 1 | Public JSON key |

That leaves roughly 1079 safe renames, all internal variables. One caution: `req.session.account_id` appears 100 times. Whoever sets that session field lives outside this repo.
